layout_rules.safe_area: All screens must wrap content in SafeAreaView to handle mobile notches. Add safe area context appropriately to headers and bottom tabs.
layout_rules.bottom_tabs: Use a clear bottom tab bar. Background white, active icon color #22C55E (Primary), inactive icon color #374151 (Dark Gray). Keep it minimal without background pills.
layout_rules.touch_targets: All interactive elements (buttons, links, chips, tab bar icons) MUST have a minimum height and width of 48dp for accessibility compliance.
layout_rules.dashboard: Keep strictly clean. Show maximum 5 cards/widgets on the screen at a time. Use a ScrollView with generous vertical padding (16px gaps). Avoid clutter.
layout_rules.lists: Use FlatList for scheme lists. Implement visual separation using either cards with 16px margins or 1px border bottoms (#E5E7EB) to clearly delineate items.
layout_rules.forms: Use KeyboardAvoidingView. Input fields must be tall (48px+). Avoid floating labels, use static clear labels above inputs for maximum legibility.
layout_rules.testing: All Touchables, Pressables, TextInputs, and essential text Views MUST include a testID property (equivalent to data-testid in React Native). E.g., testID='login-submit-button'

motion.transitions: Use native React Navigation stack transitions. Avoid heavy custom animations.
motion.feedback: Use TouchableOpacity (activeOpacity={0.7}) or Pressable with Android ripple effect (color: '#E5E7EB') for instant tactile feedback on touch.

instructions_to_main_agent: Develop the app using React Native and Expo.
Strictly follow the color palette. Absolutely no blue, no gradients, and no glassmorphism or blurred backgrounds.
Implement the UI using plain React Native StyleSheet objects with the tokens provided in this file.
For shadows, use React Native's elevation property for Android and shadowColor/Offset/Opacity for iOS as defined in the shadows object.
Use 'testID' props consistently across all touchable components and form inputs in place of 'data-testid'.
Design the dashboard for maximal clarity with high contrast text. Background should be #FFFFFF or #F3F4F6 with white cards.
The AI Advisor should mimic a clean ChatGPT interface: user messages in green, AI messages in light gray. Include an input bar at the bottom with a submit icon.
The language selection screen should be simple grid or list of cards with 9 Indian languages clearly labeled in native scripts as well as English.
Ensure touch targets are universally 48dp minimum.
